ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) with high-intensity (white) clusters at the distal tips; ratio approximately 9:1 dark to light pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity dark region across most of the surface area; high-contrast white contiguous blobs localized on the extreme left and right tips (barnacle colonies); sparse white linear pixels scattered across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible shallow U-shaped central notch dividing the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular jagged boundary with high-frequency, variable-amplitude peaks (serrations) along the entire trailing edge of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward sweep from the median notch extending towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of circular, high-contrast white pixels located on the lateral margins of both the left and right fluke tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct, thin, high-intensity white linear marks (scratches) visible on the left lobe (diagonal) and right mid-lobe (various orientations).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on both distal tips; multiple superficial white linear rake marks across the ventral surface.
